Segment properties

Source: R/properties.R
ngs_segment_properties.Rd

Create neuroglancer segment properties, e.g. to label segments or to make them searchable by tags. Start with ngs_segment_properties() and add properties with ngs_add_property(), or create them from a data frame with ngs_properties_from_df(). Write them to an info file with ngs_write_info() and convert them back with as.data.frame().

Usage

ngs_segment_properties(ids)

ngs_properties_from_df(df, id_col = "id")

ngs_properties_from_url(url)

ngs_properties_from_list(x)

Arguments

ids

Segment IDs. Must be unique.

df

A data frame with segment IDs and one column per property. See ngs_add_property() for how column types are interpreted.

id_col

Name of the column in df with the segment IDs.

url

URL of a segment properties info file, or of a segmentation source whose info file points to segment properties. precomputed:// and gs:// URLs are supported.

x

An info file parsed into a list.

Value

Segment properties.

Examples

df <- data.frame(id = c(1, 2, 3),
                 name = c("DA1_lPN", "DA1_lPN", "KCg"),
                 size = c(10.5, 12, 3),
                 class = factor(c("PN", "PN", "KC")))
props <- ngs_properties_from_df(df)
props
#> <ngs_segment_properties> 3 segments, 3 properties
#>   name (label)
#>   size (number)
#>   class (tags)
as.data.frame(props)
#>   id    name size class
#> 1  1 DA1_lPN 10.5    PN
#> 2  2 DA1_lPN 12.0    PN
#> 3  3     KCg  3.0    KC
cat(ngs_to_json(props, pretty = TRUE))
#> {
#>     "@type": "neuroglancer_segment_properties",
#>     "inline": {
#>         "ids": [
#>             "1",
#>             "2",
#>             "3"
#>         ],
#>         "properties": [
#>             {
#>                 "id": "name",
#>                 "type": "label",
#>                 "values": [
#>                     "DA1_lPN",
#>                     "DA1_lPN",
#>                     "KCg"
#>                 ]
#>             },
#>             {
#>                 "data_type": "float32",
#>                 "id": "size",
#>                 "type": "number",
#>                 "values": [
#>                     10.5,
#>                     12,
#>                     3
#>                 ]
#>             },
#>             {
#>                 "id": "class",
#>                 "tags": [
#>                     "KC",
#>                     "PN"
#>                 ],
#>                 "type": "tags",
#>                 "values": [
#>                     [
#>                         1
#>                     ],
#>                     [
#>                         1
#>                     ],
#>                     [
#>                         0
#>                     ]
#>                 ]
#>             }
#>         ]
#>     }
#> }
